identity: An Arabic multiple-choice exam / question-bank sheet (اختيار من متعدد), pooled from school social-studies and general-knowledge curricula: Qatari heritage items (فيلاجو، متحف الفن الإسلامي، كتارا، سوق واقف، القلائد والتراث المادي), Jordanian civic-history items (السلام الملكي، العلم الأردني، تعريب قيادة الجيش العربي), Islamic and ancient history (الدولة الكلدانية، العصر الذهبي للقلاع، شاعر الرسول، العرب البائدة), and civics/environment items (حقوق الطفل، الحريات، الحوادث المرورية، تلوث التربة). It is NOT running prose and must not be read as prose — that misreading is exactly what cost me 33.3 F1 on doc_25ed373f8aeb in batch 1. 339 tokens, 19 <NL>, 20 items. Every <NL> delimits exactly one question, and all 20 questions have the identical shape: one stem followed by exactly four answer options, with no lettering, no punctuation, and no connective separating the options.
law: STEM + OPTION-LIST LAW (doctrine section I), which in this genre OVERRIDES the section-0 conjunct-weight law. (1) The stem ends where the options begin, even mid-construction: a trailing preposition, copula or shared head noun is a colon in disguise and closes the stem — here ل(13), أنها(62), يد(76), من(188), إلى(234), عام(288), عام(315), plus the shared head nouns الصناعات(32), الصناعات(92), المرتبة(178), الحريات(260). (2) EVERY option is its own unit however short — a bare year (1920), a bare adjective (خصبة), a single noun (الواجبات), a year+م pair. The short-tail brake of section 0b is SUSPENDED in this genre. (3) A connective inside a stem or inside an option is NOT a boundary. Bare-noun/adjective و never cuts (وعدد السكان، والأمراض المعدية، والأدبي والرياضي، وتعليمات ركوب), and — the genre-specific part — even و + finite verb does not cut when it lies inside a single stem or a single option (وتصنف، ولم يبق، ويصونها، وتساعد). The unit here is the TASK ELEMENT (stem / option), not the clause; the format sets the granularity, exactly as in doctrine J3. (4) SHARED-HEAD DISCRIMINATOR: when the option head noun is written once it is shared and belongs to the STEM (blocks 2, 6, 11, 15 — options are then bare adjectives); when it is repeated before each option it belongs to EACH OPTION (blocks 10, 12, 16, 18 — العرب X، الحقوق X، الحريات X، شعار X). (5) Arithmetic of the law: 20 items x (1 stem + 4 options) = 100 units.
reasoning: FORMAT PROOF FIRST. Ten of the twenty blocks are internally unambiguous — their four options are unmistakable parallel siblings of the same syntactic type with zero connectives (block 1: four Qatari landmarks; block 3: three حق X phrases plus جميع ماسبق; block 5: four peoples; blocks 8 and 9: four personal names each; block 13: four verbal-noun phrases; block 17: four bare years; block 18: four شعار X; blocks 19 and 20: four year+م pairs). That is ten INDEPENDENT confirmations of doctrine I4, so exactly-four-options is established evidence rather than an assumption, and I may then use it to resolve the ambiguous blocks. All twenty blocks come out at 5 units. || HARD SITE 1 — block 6 at index 89 قطر, before وتصنف. My master law (section 0 / A1) says و + new finite predication with its own PP frame = CUT, and وتصنف ضمن الصناعات qualifies on its face. I do NOT cut, and this is the one place I consciously overrule my strongest prose law. Three reasons: (a) the stem is one question — cutting would leave تعتبر القلائد من التراث المادي في دولة قطر as a standalone assertion and strand the actual interrogative; (b) the four-option law, confirmed ten times above, gives this block exactly 5 units only if the stem runs whole to الصناعات; (c) punctuation is what was REMOVED to build this task, and in a question-bank line no separator ever sat before وتصنف — the separators sat between the options. Genre decides granularity (doctrine J3), and here the granularity is the task element. || HARD SITE 2 — block 14 at index 244 التربة, inside option 3 تغذي التربة وتساعد على نمو النبات. Same shape: و + finite verb + own PP. No cut, per doctrine I5 (options may contain internal و; boundaries go BETWEEN siblings, never inside one). Cutting would yield five options against four everywhere else. Note this option is a full finite clause while its three siblings are verbal-noun phrases — an asymmetry that tempted me toward the prose reading, recorded here as the trap it is. || HARD SITE 3 — block 16 at index 271 لمواطنيها, before ويصونها. No cut: ويصونها is a one-word coordinated verb continuing the same relative clause on حقوق, same subject (دستور), same object pronoun. Short-tail, same subject, and the four-option count all agree. Same verdict at block 10 index 155 ولم — ولم يبق منهم سوى أخبارهم continues the relative clause describing قبائل, and the four العرب X options require the stem to end at أخبارهم. || HARD SITE 4 — block 11 at index 173 حيث. My connective table lists حيث as a near-automatic CUT (A3, G1). It is NOT one here: من حيث المساحة وعدد السكان is the fixed prepositional idiom in-terms-of, not clause-introducing حيث. A connective must actually open a predication before the table applies. Trap avoided. Likewise وعدد at 175 is bare-noun و — no cut. || HARD SITE 5 — the shared-head question, blocks 2, 6, 11, 15. Does الصناعات / المرتبة / الحريات close the stem or open option 1? It closes the stem. Decisive internal evidence: this document does BOTH constructions and keeps them apart. Where the head is written once (إلى الصناعات then الهندسية البترولية المعدنية النسيجية), options 2-4 would be headless adjectives if the head belonged to option 1 — incoherent; where the annotator wants the head inside each option he repeats it (الحريات الأساسية الحريات العامة الحريات الثقافية الحريات السياسية, block 16). One writing, one reading. This is the same cataphoric-announcer cut as doctrine H1 and I2, only with a noun instead of a preposition. || HARD SITE 6 — block 12 at index 188 من. Marked med. من الواجبات is a tempting single constituent, which would put الواجبات in the stem and leave only three options. I cut after the dangling من and read الواجبات as option 1 (the distractor: is care a duty or a right?), because that alone yields the four options the format demands. If this item is wrong, 188 and 189 fall together. || HARD SITE 7 — block 7, the garbled one, my only lo. بعد العصر العصر الذهبي لبناء القلاع الإسلامية فير: بعد is almost certainly OCR for يعد, العصر is doubled around a blank slot, and فير is a corrupt token sitting exactly where a stem-final function word belongs. I read it as a mangled في and let it close the stem (boundary at 105). The alternative is that فير begins option 1, putting the stem boundary at 104 instead. The four era-adjectives الراشدي / الاموي / العباسي / الايوبي are boundaries either way, so only this single index is at risk. || CALIBRATION NOTE. My batch-1 profile is 7:1 under-segmentation, so my standing rule is to justify every non-cut. The four non-cuts above (89, 244, 271, 155) rest not on caution but on a positively established format law. Against that, the genre pushes the other way and I have taken every one of the seven dangling-function-word cuts and every single-token option: sixty of the hundred boundaries fall inside option lists that a prose reading would have swallowed whole, which is precisely the failure mode that produced 33.3 on doc_25ed373f8aeb.
